function generateCarouselItemListSchema(items?, baseUrl?): Record<string, unknown> | null

Defined in: core/utils/schema.ts:72

Generates an ItemList matching Google Carousel rich results guidelines — position is 1-based per the spec, and image is only emitted when the item carries a src (an absent property beats an empty one for parsers).

Parameters

items?

CarouselSchemaItem[] = []

baseUrl?

string = NET_STRINGS.SITE_URL

Returns

Record<string, unknown> | null

ItemList entity, or null when there is nothing to list.
